policy: These are human-labelled fixtures. G18a runs no external model and records no generated model judgement.

cases.claim: The latest migration is schema v20.
cases.reason: The canonical constant is 27. The stale prose is deliberately preserved for the audit.

cases.claim: The canonical SQLite schema version is 27.
cases.reason: Positive control paired with the real drift case.

cases.claim: Recoll is not the canonical document store.
cases.reason: The canonical Store interface and SQLite adapter own document state.

cases.claim: Recoll is the canonical document store.
cases.reason: Only one negation differs from the supported control, defeating similarity-as-agreement.

cases.claim: Deleting a live note moves it to Trash, where it can be restored.
cases.reason: The root handlers and their direct API callees implement both halves.

cases.claim: Deleting a live note immediately and permanently removes every revision.
cases.reason: The ordinary delete route is distinct from purge and the UI exposes restoration.

cases.claim: SQLite was chosen because it makes Notrios pleasant to maintain.
cases.reason: A motivation is not an executable behavioral claim and must remain unmarked rationale.

cases.claim: Every cloud provider preserves modification times for carrier artifacts.
cases.reason: The claim is external and universal; a declaration plus direct same-package callees cannot establish it.
